title: Regulated release, audit export, dependency loss, restore, and continuity grant
accessibility: Continuity and audit exports have accessible alternatives to visual-only reports
Public approved-final access remains keyboard and screen-reader operable
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Audit export is tenant-scoped, attributable, integrity-verifiable, and redacted
Residency, legal hold, and retention survive failover and restore
Producer billing state cannot revoke a commissioned approved final
persistence: Database, media manifest, checksums, delivery record, and licensing/source manifest restore coherently
Append-only audit and usage receipts preserve chain integrity after restore
concurrency: Writes during failover have a defined fencing and reconciliation policy
Restore rehearsal does not overwrite newer production state
degradedDependencies: Regional database, storage, queue, provider, and notification loss are rehearsed
Synthetics distinguish liveness, readiness, degraded service, and policy failure
rollback: Application and schema rollback meet the current RTO without losing retained authority
A Continuity Pack remains verifiable independent of the live SaaS
